asr.limitations: Exclude and list rows with an empty normalized reference; blank hypotheses count as errors. Use summed edit counts divided by summed reference words/characters for corpus WER/CER; report macro per-record means separately. Existing historical reports with inconsistent aggregate counters require reconciliation before comparison.

metrics.signature: scripts/asr_metrics.py: NFC, casefold, punctuation/symbol to spaces, whitespace collapse; edit distance over whitespace words; preserve corpus edit and reference-word totals
same normalization; edit distance over normalized characters with spaces removed; preserve corpus edit and reference-character totals

language_modeling.limitations: This character model is a small diagnostic baseline, not a neural language-model result. Values are comparable only when order, training rows, normalization, and boundary policy match.

metrics.implementation_status: frozen_protocol; current saved baseline is character bigram order 2
metrics.signature: NFC+whitespace-collapse; add-one-smoothed character n-gram; record order and training corpus hash; include explicit boundary symbols; report negative log likelihood per evaluated character, character denominator, and exp(loss) perplexity; compare only identical orders and preprocessing.

question_answering.limitations: The export computes no model scores. Explicit no-answer scoring is unsupported; rows without a non-empty Garhwali answer reference are retained but excluded and listed. The current usage overlay marks 138 records with exact context, source-page, question, or oracle-question overlap as open-diagnostic-only for independent source-generalization claims.

metrics.signature: NFC+casefold; Unicode punctuation and symbols become spaces; collapsed whitespace tokens; exact match and multiset token F1; maximum per-record score across non-empty references; macro mean; empty hypotheses score zero and remain in the denominator; records without a non-empty reference are rejected; scripts/benchmark_metrics.py:score_qa_answers

retrieval.limitations: Candidate corpus identity and its all-source-split composition must be stated. The fixed-corpus development score does not measure unseen-page generalization; source-page bootstrap is a separate uncertainty analysis.

metrics.signature: Rank the fixed, hash-identified candidate corpus by descending BM25 score with document-ID ascending as the deterministic tie-break. One row-associated deduplicated gold document is relevant per query. Recall@k is 1 when that document has positive score and rank <= k, else 0; MRR@10 is 1/rank for positive-scored ranks <= 10, else 0. The denominator includes every evaluated non-empty query, including zero-score misses; macro-average across that denominator; report requested, scored, missing-query and zero-score counts.

summarization.limitations: The export computes no model scores. Rows without a non-empty summary reference are retained but excluded from scoring and listed by ID. The score does not validate summary meaning or reference quality.

metrics.signature: NFC+casefold+whitespace-collapse; remove whitespace for character n-grams; orders 1-6; corpus precision and recall per order; beta=2 F-score per order; arithmetic mean across orders; empty hypotheses contribute zero precision.

NFC+casefold; Unicode punctuation and symbols become spaces; collapsed whitespace tokens; token LCS F1; macro mean of per-record maximum across non-empty references; empty hypotheses score zero and remain in the denominator; scripts/benchmark_metrics.py:score_rouge_l

translation.limitations: The exported scorer uses one non-empty reference per included row. This custom metric is not SacreBLEU and does not establish translation correctness.

metrics.signature: NFC+casefold+whitespace-collapse; corpus word n-grams orders 1-4; add-one precision smoothing per order; corpus brevity penalty; scripts/run_translation_baseline.py:corpus_bleu
NFC+casefold+whitespace-collapse; character n-grams orders 1-6; beta=2; per-order corpus precision/recall F-beta macro-average; scripts/run_translation_baseline.py:corpus_chrf
